summary: Frontend-only verification of the 'CRM login link not working' fix as a logged-out visitor (clean context). All 5 requested flows pass: header 'CRM login' link (data-testid=crm-login-link) navigates / -> /login and renders login-page with google-signin-btn; both footer links (footer-crm-login, footer-partner-login) have href=/login and navigate to the Sign in card; direct navigation to /login renders login-page and does NOT redirect away; back-to-site-link returns to /; public-signin-btn coexists with crm-login-link for logged-out users; regression: /dashboard while logged out redirects to landing page with no crash and 0 error elements. Also verified on mobile (390x844) — footer link works. Backend testing skipped per request.

ui_bugs.issue: Header 'CRM login' link uses 'hidden sm:inline' so it is invisible below 640px and there is no mobile hamburger nav; on phones the only path to /login is the page footer. Verified hidden at 390px.

issues: Large empty area in the upper half of the left brand panel — brand block at very top, hero content anchored low, leaving a big vertical gap (justify-between with sparse content). Cosmetic only, out of declared scope.

action_items: Optional: expose the CRM login link on mobile (<640px) via a mobile menu or drop the 'hidden sm:inline' class, since the header link is the primary discoverable entry point.
critical_code_review_comments: Both footer links (footer-crm-login and footer-partner-login) point to the same /login route; acceptable since role routing happens post-auth, but the 'Channel Partner login' label may mislead users expecting a partner-specific screen.

App.js logged-out branch has a catch-all Navigate to '/', so any deep link (e.g. /dashboard) silently loses the intended destination — consider preserving a ?next= param to redirect after Google auth.
test_credentials: not needed — logged-out testing only; Continue with Google was not clicked
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login link fix verified end-to-end at https://credit-ops-5.preview.emergentagent.com. Expected console noise: two 401s from the /api/auth/me session check on every logged-out page load (harmless). Remaining unverified: authenticated internal-team routing (/login -> /dashboard redirect for logged-in staff) since Google OAuth cannot be completed in-browser here.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug was a missing/incorrect public entry point to /login; current code adds Link to /login in PublicNav (line 38) and in the footer (lines 74-75), and App.js registers the /login route in the !user branch (line 74). Verified working.
